primary_claim: Using a public SAE on Anthropic's open-source deceptive model organism (Llama 3.3 70B Instruct + deceptive LoRA), 43 features pass Bonferroni correction as consistently more active during concealment than confession responses, with the signal appearing only when measuring assistant responses in isolation rather than full conversation context.

effect.value: 43 features at Bonferroni threshold (alpha ~= 7.6e-7); 54 features at p<0.001

contradicts_or_qualifies: extends Sheshadri et al. (2025), who conducted a brief SAE analysis identifying only a single exploitation-associated feature without systematically comparing concealment vs confession responses
limitations_stated: SAE trained on base model, applied to LoRA-modified activations
mean pooling may obscure token-level dynamics
